title: Randomization Tests in Randomized Saturation Designs
abstract: arXiv:2607.04257v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Randomized saturation designs are widely used to study spillover effects in clustered populations. In these designs, clusters are first assigned to treatment saturation levels, and units are then randomized within clusters according to the assigned saturation. This paper develops randomization tests for such experiments under several null hypotheses that arise naturally in spillover analysis. We first compare each unit's untreated potential outcomes at two saturation levels: the partially sharp null requires zero spillover for every unit, while the bounded null imposes a prespecified upper bound on each unit's spillover effect. Both hypotheses can be tested using a common conditional randomization framework that provides finite-sample validity. translated_title: 随机化饱和设计中的随机化检验
translated_abstract: 随机化饱和设计被广泛用于研究集群总体中的溢出效应。在这类设计中，首先将各集群分配到不同的处理饱和水平，然后根据指定的饱和水平在集群内部对个体进行随机化处理。本文针对此类实验，在溢出分析中自然产生的若干原假设下发展了随机化检验方法。我们首先比较每个个体在两个饱和水平上的未处理潜在结果：部分锐零假设要求每个个体的溢出效应为零，而有界零假设则对每个个体的溢出效应施加预先设定的上界。这两类假设都可以在一个提供有限样本有效性的共同条件随机化框架下进行检验。接着，我们开发了一个有限样本有效的无条件随机化检验，用于检验每个个体的未处理潜在结果是否随饱和水平单调不减。最后，我们研究了弱……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文针对随机化饱和设计，提出了在部分锐零假设、有界零假设及单调性假设等多种溢出分析原假设下均具有有限样本有效性的随机化检验方法。
en_tdlr: This paper develops finite-sample valid randomization tests for randomized saturation designs under several null hypotheses arising in spillover analysis, including partially sharp nulls, bounded nulls, and monotonicity assumptions.
